name: Real Estate House Tour
place: A residential suburban home for sale
role: You are a real estate agent.
speaker: Real Estate Agent

tasks.goal: Greet the real estate agent and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the real estate agent and stated purpose.

Japanese.goal: 不動産業者にあいさつして来訪の目的を伝える
Japanese.hint: 到着したら、まず来訪の目的をはっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about house asking price and property square footage
tasks.hint: Ask real estate agent key details about house.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about property asking price and square footage.

Japanese.goal: 物件の売り出し価格と床面積について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 家の主な情報を不動産業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about age of roof, HVAC heating system, and water heater
tasks.hint: Inquire about main mechanical systems in home.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about roof age and HVAC heating systems.

Japanese.goal: 屋根、空調・暖房設備、給湯器の築年数について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 家の主な設備について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inspect kitchen countertops, cabinet storage, and stainless appliances
tasks.hint: Evaluate kitchen layout during walkthrough.
tasks.done_when: Learner inspected kitchen features during house tour.
tasks.scene_hint: Sunlight fills spacious living room as footsteps echo on polished hardwood.

Japanese.goal: キッチンのカウンター、収納棚、ステンレス製の家電を確認する
Japanese.hint: 内見しながらキッチンの使い勝手を確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about local school district ratings and neighborhood safety
tasks.hint: Inquire about surrounding area amenities.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about school district and neighborhood safety.

Japanese.goal: 地元の学区の評価と近所の治安について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 周辺環境について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'easement'
tasks.hint: An easement is a legal right to cross or use someone else land for a specific purpose. Ask if there is a municipal utility easement along the property boundary.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'easement'.

Japanese.goal: 「地役権」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 地役権とは、特定の目的で他人の土地を通行・利用できる法的な権利です。敷地の境界沿いに市の公共設備のための地役権があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about annual property tax estimates and HOA monthly fees
tasks.hint: Ask about recurring ownership expenses.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about property taxes and HOA fees.

Japanese.goal: 年間の固定資産税の見込み額と管理組合の月額費用について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 所有するうえで毎年・毎月かかる費用について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate asking seller to cover closing costs or home warranty
tasks.hint: Ask agent if seller concessions can be requested.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated seller coverage for closing costs.

Japanese.goal: 諸費用か住宅保証を売り主に負担してもらうよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: 売り主に譲歩をお願いできるか、業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if home inspection revealed any structural foundation issues
tasks.hint: Inquire about seller disclosure report.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about home inspection and foundation reports.

Japanese.goal: 住宅診断で基礎の構造上の問題が見つかったか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 売り主の告知書について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Express concern over noisy street traffic heard from master bedroom
tasks.hint: Point out location issue during tour.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed concern about street noise in master bedroom.
tasks.scene_hint: Front yard lawn sign waves gently in breeze outside front entryway.

Japanese.goal: 主寝室から聞こえる車の騒音について懸念を伝える
Japanese.hint: 内見中に気づいた立地の問題を指摘しましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about property boundaries and backyard fence line clearance
tasks.hint: Inquire about lot dimensions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about property lot boundaries and fence line.

Japanese.goal: 敷地の境界と裏庭のフェンスの位置について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 土地の寸法について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm earnest money deposit requirements for making purchase offer
tasks.hint: Verify financial terms for submitting offer.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed earnest money deposit requirements.

Japanese.goal: 購入申込みに必要な手付金の条件を確認する
Japanese.hint: 申込みをする際のお金の条件を確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printed property brochure and seller disclosure statement
tasks.hint: Ask agent for paper house informational packet.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested property brochure and disclosure form.

Japanese.goal: 印刷された物件パンフレットと売り主の告知書を頼む
Japanese.hint: 紙の物件資料をもらえるか業者に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm timeline for submitting formal purchase offer to seller
tasks.hint: Ask when offer deadline expires.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed offer submission deadline timeline.

Japanese.goal: 売り主に正式な購入申込みを出す期限を確認する
Japanese.hint: 申込みの締め切りがいつか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the real estate agent and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the real estate agent AND said goodbye.

Japanese.goal: 不動産業者にお礼を言って別れのあいさつをする
Japanese.hint: 感謝の気持ちを伝えて、会話を締めくくりましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about school district zoning boundaries and nearest public school ratings
tasks.hint: Ask realtor which school district covers this address.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about school district zoning and ratings.
tasks.scene_hint: Sunlight streams onto polished hardwood floors through clean living room windows.

Japanese.goal: 学区の区割りと最寄りの公立学校の評価について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: この住所がどの学区に入るか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about home sellers motivation and expected closing date flexibility
tasks.hint: Inquire why owners are moving and if closing date is flexible.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about seller motivation and closing flexibility.
tasks.scene_hint: A printed open house feature sheet rests on the granite kitchen island.

Japanese.goal: 売り主が売る理由と引き渡し日の融通について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: なぜ引っ越すのか、引き渡し日は調整できるかを聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if recent professional property inspection report is available for review
tasks.hint: Ask realtor for copy of pre-listing inspection.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pre-listing inspection report availability.
tasks.scene_hint: Fresh paint aroma fills spacious entry foyer featuring hardwood floors.

Japanese.goal: 最近の専門家による住宅診断報告書を見られるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 売り出し前に行った住宅診断の報告書のコピーを頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'encumbrance'
tasks.hint: An encumbrance is a legal claim or liability attached to a property title. Inquire if any financial or structural encumbrance exists on the parcel.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'encumbrance'.

Japanese.goal: 「抵当」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 抵当とは、物件の権利に付いている法的な権利や負債のことです。この土地に金銭面や構造面での負担があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'fixtures'
tasks.hint: Fixtures are physical items permanently attached to real estate property. Clarify whether built-in shelving units count as included fixtures.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'fixtures'.

Japanese.goal: 「造作」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 造作とは、建物に固定されて取り外せない設備のことです。作り付けの棚が付帯する造作に含まれるか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'overhang'
tasks.hint: An overhang is a supporting structure extending beyond a wall. Inquire about roof overhang drainage maintenance during the house tour.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'overhang'.

Japanese.goal: 「張り出し」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 張り出しとは、壁より外に突き出した部分のことです。内見中に、屋根の張り出し部分の排水や手入れについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'assessment'
tasks.hint: An assessment is an official property valuation or special local tax levy. Ask about recent municipal tax assessment increases in the neighborhood.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'assessment'.

Japanese.goal: 「査定」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 査定とは、公的な物件の評価や地域の特別な課税のことです。この地域で最近、市の課税評価額が上がったか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about age and maintenance history of central heating and air conditioning HVAC system
tasks.hint: Inquire when furnace and AC unit were installed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about HVAC system age and maintenance.
tasks.scene_hint: The quiet hum of central air conditioning blows softly from ceiling vents in the hallway.

Japanese.goal: セントラル冷暖房設備の築年数と整備の履歴について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 暖房炉とエアコンがいつ設置されたか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if home is located within designated 100-year flood zone requiring flood policy
tasks.hint: Ask realtor about regional flood risk rating.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about flood zone designation.
tasks.scene_hint: A neighborhood parcel map showing elevation contours lies on the kitchen counter.

Japanese.goal: 家が保険加入の必要な「百年に一度」の洪水想定区域にあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: この地域の洪水リスクの評価について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask whether neighborhood homeowners association HOA charges monthly or annual dues
tasks.hint: Inquire about HOA fee amount and payment frequency.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about HOA fee details.

Japanese.goal: 地域の管理組合費が月払いか年払いか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 管理組合費の金額と支払いの頻度を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Point out hairline crack observed along living room drywall corner
tasks.hint: Inform realtor of visible wall plaster crack.
tasks.done_when: Learner pointed out drywall crack during tour.
tasks.scene_hint: Sunlight streaming through bay window illuminates fine hairline crack near ceiling beam.

Japanese.goal: リビングの石こうボードの角に細いひびがあることを指摘する
Japanese.hint: 壁に見えるひびについて業者に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about electrical panel amperage capacity and circuit breaker upgrades
tasks.hint: Ask if electrical service panel is 200 amps.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about electrical panel capacity.

Japanese.goal: 分電盤の容量（アンペア数）とブレーカーの交換歴について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 分電盤が200アンペアかどうか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if double-pane glass windows provide sound insulation against street traffic noise
tasks.hint: Inquire about window noise reduction quality.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about window noise insulation.

Japanese.goal: 複層ガラスの窓に道路の騒音を防ぐ効果があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 窓の防音性能について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request seller disclosure statement regarding past roof leaks or basement water intrusion
tasks.hint: Ask realtor for formal seller disclosure form.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested seller property disclosure statement.

Japanese.goal: 過去の雨漏りや地下室の浸水についての売り主の告知書を頼む
Japanese.hint: 売り主の正式な告知書を業者に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about water pressure and plumbing pipe materials like copper or PEX
tasks.hint: Ask if plumbing pipes are updated.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about plumbing materials and water pressure.

Japanese.goal: 水圧と、銅管や樹脂管など配管の材質について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 配管が新しくなっているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Express concern over lack of storage space and small bedroom closet dimensions
tasks.hint: Mention concern that master closet feels undersized.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed concern about closet storage space.
tasks.scene_hint: Realtor slides open closet door revealing narrow hanging rod and single shelf.

Japanese.goal: 収納が少ないことと寝室のクローゼットが狭いことに懸念を伝える
Japanese.hint: 主寝室のクローゼットが小さく感じると伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if kitchen appliances like refrigerator and stove are included in purchase price
tasks.hint: Inquire which kitchen appliances stay with house.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about included kitchen appliances.

Japanese.goal: 冷蔵庫やコンロなどのキッチン家電が購入価格に含まれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: どのキッチン家電が家に残されるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about annual property tax bill amount paid during previous tax year
tasks.hint: Ask realtor exact property tax figure.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about annual property tax amount.

Japanese.goal: 前年度に支払った年間の固定資産税の金額について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 固定資産税の正確な金額を業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if property relies on municipal sewer network or private septic tank system
tasks.hint: Inquire about wastewater drainage setup.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sewer vs septic system.

Japanese.goal: 物件が公共下水道か個別の浄化槽か尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 排水の仕組みについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Point out water stain mark observed on basement ceiling drywall
tasks.hint: Inform realtor of dark moisture discoloration on ceiling.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported basement ceiling water stain.
tasks.scene_hint: Damp earthy scent lingers near far corner of unfinished basement ceiling.

Japanese.goal: 地下室の天井の石こうボードに水じみがあることを指摘する
Japanese.hint: 天井に湿気による黒っぽい変色があることを業者に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about average winter heating utility bills and insulation quality in attic
tasks.hint: Inquire about home energy efficiency expenses.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about winter heating utility costs.

Japanese.goal: 冬の平均的な暖房費と屋根裏の断熱性について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 家の光熱費と省エネ性能について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if neighborhood restrictions limit exterior house paint colors or fence heights
tasks.hint: Ask about HOA design covenant rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about neighborhood HOA exterior restrictions.

Japanese.goal: 外壁の色やフェンスの高さに地域の規制があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 管理組合のデザインに関する規約について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate seller credit for roof repair after observing missing shingles
tasks.hint: Ask realtor if seller would cover roof repair expenses.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated seller roof repair credit.

Japanese.goal: 屋根材の欠けを見つけたので、屋根の修理費の値引きを売り主と交渉する
Japanese.hint: 屋根の修理費を売り主が負担してくれるか業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request comparative market analysis CMA report for recent sales in neighborhood
tasks.hint: Ask realtor for sales prices of similar nearby houses.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested market analysis of nearby sales.

Japanese.goal: 近所の最近の売買事例をまとめた比較市場分析の報告書を頼む
Japanese.hint: 近くの似た家がいくらで売れたか業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about property boundary line locations and existing backyard fencing ownership
tasks.hint: Ask who owns shared property line fence.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about property line fence ownership.

Japanese.goal: 敷地の境界線の位置と裏庭のフェンスの所有者について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 境界にあるフェンスが誰のものか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if foundation basement walls show signs of horizontal bowing or dampness
tasks.hint: Inquire about structural foundation integrity.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about foundation wall condition.

Japanese.goal: 地下室の基礎の壁に横方向のたわみや湿気の兆候があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 基礎の構造がしっかりしているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify whether backyard storage shed and patio furniture remain on property
tasks.hint: Ask realtor if outbuildings are included in sale.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified inclusion of outdoor shed.
tasks.scene_hint: Wooden garden shed sits beside overgrown flowerbed near back fence.

Japanese.goal: 裏庭の物置とテラス用の家具が物件に残るか確認する
Japanese.hint: 付属の建物が売買に含まれるか業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about internet service provider options and fiber optic cable availability
tasks.hint: Inquire about high-speed internet access at address.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fiber internet provider availability.

Japanese.goal: インターネット回線業者の選択肢と光回線が使えるかについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: この住所で高速インターネットが使えるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about nearby public transit bus stops and commuter train station proximity
tasks.hint: Ask realtor about local transit connections.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about public transit proximity.

Japanese.goal: 近くのバス停と通勤用の駅までの距離について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 周辺の交通の便について業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about original hardwood flooring beneath wall-to-wall bedroom carpeting
tasks.hint: Inquire if genuine wood floors lie under carpet.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about hardwood floors under carpet.

Japanese.goal: 寝室の敷き詰めカーペットの下に元のフローリングがあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: カーペットの下に本物の木の床があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about local neighborhood noise levels during evening weekend hours
tasks.hint: Ask realtor if neighborhood is quiet at night.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about evening neighborhood noise levels.

Japanese.goal: 週末の夜の近所の騒音の程度について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 夜は静かな地域かどうか業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if water heater tank capacity is sufficient for multi-person household
tasks.hint: Inquire about water heater size and age.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about water heater tank capacity.

Japanese.goal: 給湯器のタンク容量が複数人の家族に足りるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 給湯器の大きさと使用年数を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request information on recent home additions or unpermitted structural remodels
tasks.hint: Ask if garage conversion was built with city permits.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested unpermitted remodel details.
tasks.scene_hint: Realtor flips through property feature sheet pointing to renovated bonus room.

Japanese.goal: 最近の増築や無許可の構造的な改築について情報を頼む
Japanese.hint: ガレージの改装が市の許可を得て行われたか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about master bathroom vanity counter material like granite or quartz
tasks.hint: Ask about bathroom countertop finishes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bathroom vanity materials.

Japanese.goal: 主寝室の洗面台のカウンターが御影石かクオーツかなど素材について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 浴室のカウンターの仕上げについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if property features automatic lawn sprinkler system with multi-zone timer
tasks.hint: Inquire about outdoor irrigation system.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about lawn sprinkler system.

Japanese.goal: 複数の区画を設定できるタイマー付きの自動スプリンクラーがあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 屋外の散水設備について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask whether home security system hardware and cameras transfer with title
tasks.hint: Inquire if alarm equipment is included in sale.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if security hardware stays with house.

Japanese.goal: 防犯システムの機器やカメラが所有権と一緒に引き継がれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 防犯機器が売買に含まれるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate seller warranty coverage inclusion for key major home appliances
tasks.hint: Ask if seller will include one-year home warranty policy.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated home appliance warranty inclusion.

Japanese.goal: 主な家電を保証の対象に含めるよう売り主と交渉する
Japanese.hint: 売り主が1年間の住宅保証を付けてくれるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about termite infestation inspection history and chemical treatment records
tasks.hint: Inquire about pest control history on property.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pest and termite inspection history.

Japanese.goal: シロアリの検査履歴と薬剤処理の記録について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: この物件の害虫駆除の履歴について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about attic ventilation fans and roof ridge vent installation
tasks.hint: Ask if attic has proper airflow vents.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about attic ventilation system.

Japanese.goal: 屋根裏の換気扇と棟換気の設置について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 屋根裏に適切な換気口があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if driveways asphalt paving requires immediate resurfacing or sealing
tasks.hint: Inquire about driveway pavement condition.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about driveway resurfacing needs.

Japanese.goal: 車道のアスファルト舗装をすぐに補修や塗装する必要があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 車道の舗装の状態について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request clarification on property boundary setback rules for future pool installation
tasks.hint: Ask how close to property line pool can be built.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about swimming pool setback rules.

Japanese.goal: 将来プールを作る場合の境界からの後退距離の規則について説明を頼む
Japanese.hint: 境界線からどれくらい離せばプールを作れるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if kitchen features soft-close cabinet drawers and pantry pull-out shelves
tasks.hint: Inquire about custom kitchen cabinetry hardware.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about soft-close kitchen drawers.

Japanese.goal: キッチンの引き出しがソフトクローズ式か、パントリーに引き出し式の棚があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: キッチン収納の金具や仕様について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about nearby public parks, walking trails, and recreational facilities
tasks.hint: Ask realtor about neighborhood parks and green spaces.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about nearby parks and trails.

Japanese.goal: 近くの公園、散歩道、レクリエーション施設について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 近所の公園や緑地について業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if basement sump pump includes battery backup power during blackout
tasks.hint: Inquire if basement pump operates during outages.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sump pump battery backup.

Japanese.goal: 地下室の排水ポンプに停電時用のバッテリーが付いているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 停電中も地下室のポンプが動くか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about smart home automated thermostat and keyless entry door lock compatibility
tasks.hint: Ask if smart thermostat stays with house.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about smart home thermostat inclusion.

Japanese.goal: スマート温度調節器と鍵なしで開けられるドアロックに対応しているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: スマート温度調節器が家に残るか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if fireplace chimney flu requires professional masonry sweep and cleaning
tasks.hint: Inquire about fireplace operation and safety.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about chimney safety inspection needs.

Japanese.goal: 暖炉の煙突に専門業者による掃除や点検が必要か尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 暖炉の使い方と安全性について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about earnest money deposit percentage required when submitting purchase offer
tasks.hint: Ask realtor recommended earnest deposit amount.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about earnest money deposit requirements.

Japanese.goal: 購入申込みの際に必要な手付金の割合について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 手付金はいくらぐらいがよいか業者に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm offer submission deadline time and seller response window duration
tasks.hint: Verify when purchase offer must be submitted.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed offer deadline and response window.

Japanese.goal: 申込みの締め切り時刻と売り主が回答するまでの期間を確認する
Japanese.hint: 購入申込みをいつまでに出す必要があるか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate seller inclusion of washer and dryer units in purchase contract offer
tasks.hint: Ask realtor to add laundry appliances to written offer.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated washer dryer inclusion in offer.

Japanese.goal: 洗濯機と乾燥機を購入申込みの契約に含めるよう売り主と交渉する
Japanese.hint: 申込書に洗濯機と乾燥機を加えてもらうよう業者に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for realtor business card and printed property feature brochure sheet
tasks.hint: Request paper property information packet.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested business card and property brochure.
tasks.scene_hint: Realtor pulls glossy color brochure packet from leather briefcase.

Japanese.goal: 業者の名刺と物件の特徴をまとめた印刷パンフレットを頼む
Japanese.hint: 紙の物件資料をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Request formal purchase contract template to review contingencies with real estate attorney
tasks.hint: Ask realtor for blank contract paperwork.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested purchase agreement template document.

Japanese.goal: 弁護士と条件を確認するため、正式な売買契約書のひな形を頼む
Japanese.hint: 記入前の契約書類を業者に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm scheduled follow-up phone call time to discuss offer strategy
tasks.hint: Set time for next strategy call with realtor.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed follow-up phone appointment.

Japanese.goal: 申込みの戦略を話し合う電話の予定時刻を確認する
Japanese.hint: 次に業者と電話で相談する時間を決めましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if driveway entrance width allows parking for two large vehicles side-by-side
tasks.hint: Inquire about driveway parking capacity.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about driveway side-by-side parking space.

Japanese.goal: 車道の入口の幅が大きな車2台を並べて停められるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 車道に何台停められるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about neighborhood trash pick-up days and municipal recycling bin rules
tasks.hint: Ask realtor about municipal waste collection schedule.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about neighborhood trash collection rules.

Japanese.goal: 近所のごみの収集日と市のリサイクル用ごみ箱の決まりについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 市のごみ収集の予定について業者に聞いてみましょう。
